Title: NETMESSAGE:Sven Viking (radio):\nGo back, there are campers out there!\nYour mission is to infiltrate that building.
Translation: Sven Viking（无线电）：\n回去，外面有埋伏的人！\n你的任务是潜入那座建筑。

Title:
NETMESSAGE:Sniper:
Rage Squad, we must split. These guys can respawn, they'll infiltrate the building alone.
The rest are with me, we push the frontline, go!
CLEAR THAT AREA!
Translation:
狙击手：
愤怒小队，我们必须分开。这些家伙可以重生，他们会独自潜入建筑。
其余的人跟我来，我们推进前线，走！
清理那片区域！

Title: NETMESSAGE:Door breaching virtuoso:\nNo time left, I'm breaching now!\nWe'll hold them back, GO!
Translation: 破门专家：\n没时间了，我现在就破门！\n我们会挡住他们，快走！

Title: NETMESSAGE:Sniper (echo from above):\nAnother chopper is down! We are pushing the frontline!\nLooks like you need a hand down there, take this!
Translation: 狙击手（上方回声）：\n又有一架直升机被击落！我们正在推进前线！\n看来你在下面需要帮手，拿着这个！

Title: NETMESSAGE:Tactical Nightvision Attachment: ACQUIRED\nFlashlight: REPLACED
Translation: 战术夜视仪配件：已获取\n手电筒：已替换

Title: NETMESSAGE:Enemy Grunt:\nFOR MY SQUAD, ALIEN BASTARDS!!!
Translation: 敌方小兵：\n为了我的小队，外星杂碎！！！
